department: Kisan Kalyan and Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Provides financial protection to eligible farmers against crop loss or damage caused by covered unforeseen events.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas and meeting the current PMFBY rules are eligible.
required_documents: Other documents as required for the notified season
application_process: Farmers can apply through the officially notified PMFBY application process for the relevant crop season and notified area.
application_mode: Online / As per officially notified process
